environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to ALB with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority 1 with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) custom rule group 'app-layer-constraints' priority 2 containing a regex match rule on query string values matching pattern ['";\-\-] with BLOCK action and TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet priority 3 in default BLOCK mode. WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metric namespace 'AppWAF' with alarm on BlockedRequests > 0 in 60s period.

config.rule_group_1: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet, priority 1, SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING overridden to COUNT
config.rule_group_2: custom 'app-layer-constraints', priority 2, regex ['";\-\-] on QUERY_STRING values with URL_DECODE+LOWERCASE transforms, action BLOCK
